name: BADM 3235
title: Venture Planning, Management, and Growth
description: (Also offered as MENT 3235.) An exposure to multiple facets of starting and managing new ventures in a very hands-on fashion.  The course involves an integration of business skills that are required for preparing and pitching new business plans.
requirement_description: Open only to non-BUSN students of junior or higher status. Recommended preparation: BADM or MENT 3234; BADM 3740 or MENT 3101; and ACCT or BADM 2101.
